title: Genie Ontology is now generally available
body: [Genie Ontology](/aws/en/genie/genie-ontology) is now [generally available](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Genie Ontology is the context layer that gives Genie One, Genie Code, and other AI agents a business-aware map of your organization. It combines modeled knowledge that you define in [Unity Catalog semantics](/aws/en/uc-semantics) with learned knowledge that Genie extracts from your assets and usage.
